claims.scope: The study identifies southward deep western boundary flow at 47°, 36°, and 24.5°N in decadal inverse solutions. This is a North Atlantic segment only; sections from different cruises do not establish one simultaneous continuous path or a whole-Atlantic current length. The derived floor is unranked.
claims.source_locator: Section 3.2.3 and Figure 8, DWBC at 47°N, 36°N, and 24.5°N; OSW WGS84 meridional gate calculation

geometries.method: Editorial point east of Abaco on the observed 26.5°N Atlantic section; not a whole-current path or endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

gate_distance_sensitivity.interpretation: Finite gate-perturbation scenarios; not a statistical confidence interval, measured current path, or whole-current length range.
gate_distance_sensitivity.perturbation_basis: OSW editorial sensitivity choice; not source-reported positional uncertainty.
gate_distance_sensitivity.rank_interpretation: Possible position by geographic gate separation within these seven source-gated spans; excludes along-current length and the published-length ranking. Overlap does not establish equal current length.

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
